IGUI_MVM_ClaimDisclosure:
Claim this vehicle?
Other players will not be able to drive, open, refuel or take parts from it without your permission.
Weapons, zombies and crashes can still damage it, and a modified client may briefly sit in a seat before being removed.

IGUI_MVM_ConfirmImportMVCK:
Import every Mysterious Vehicle Claim Key claim into this mod?
Loaded vehicles move over now; the rest move over the next time they load.
MVCK data is not deleted. You can run this again to pick up new claims. Remove MVCK from the server once you are happy.

IGUI_MVM_Slots_Failed: Paid claim slots did not start on this server. Ask an admin to check the server log.

IGUI_MVM_Slots_GraceLeft: Rental ended. Grace period: %1 h left - renew to keep the rented slots.

IGUI_MVM_Slots_AutoRenewNotOffered: Automatic renewal is not offered on this server.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_AutoRenewSent: Sent. The automatic renewal setting changes once the server confirms it.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_AutoRenewUnknown: No answer from the server. The automatic renewal setting is refreshed from the server; this never charges you.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_ConfirmAutoRenew:
Renew automatically when each rental ends?
Each renewal costs %1 %2 for %3 slot(s) and lasts %4 days.
If the server changes the price or terms, automatic renewal pauses until you accept again. You can turn it off at any time.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_Paused: Sales are paused on this server. Slots you already have still count.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_PermanentLimit: You already own the maximum of %1 permanent slots.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_PermanentOff: Permanent slots are not for sale.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_QuoteRenew: Extend your rental of %1 slot(s) by %2 days.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_QuoteShort: Not enough %1: you have %2 and need %3 more.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_QuoteNote: The server holds this price for a short time. If the connection drops you are never charged twice.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_QuoteNoAnswer: No answer from the server; nothing was charged. Try again.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_WaitSave: Paid. The server has not saved it yet; the new slots count once it is saved.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_SaveUnknown: Paid, but the server cannot confirm it was saved yet. Check again later; you are not charged again.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_RolledBack: The server went back to an earlier save before this purchase was stored: the payment and the slots were both undone.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_Duplicate: This purchase was already processed; you were not charged again.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_NoAnswer: No answer from the server. You are never charged twice; use Check purchase result.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_NoOrder: The server has no new purchase from you, so nothing was charged.
IGUI_MVM_Slots_NoEconomyAdmin: Managing prices needs Economy admin rights.
IGUI_MVM_NeedQuotaRange: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100
